# SPD-010 — Per-ticket Team card and Fleet.base#Team view

## Brief
Eric's stated need, 2026-09-12: click a ticket and see the lead, every spudagent under it with persona, model and status, and a summary of what they worked on and built. The spike's question 8 answer ([[SPD-006]]) proposes two pieces. (1) A `Team` view in `Fleet.base` filtered `ticket == this`, embedded in every ticket note as `![[Fleet.base#Team]]`; this needs no database and can land first on today's frontmatter. (2) A generated `## Team` table written by `spud render` from `members`: lead first, lineage order, persona (with `agent_type` for contractors), model tier and resolved model, status, run and duration, tokens and tool uses, and a "worked on / built" paragraph from `members.summary` with fallbacks to the first paragraph of `result` and then to `return_text`.

Part 2 depends on [[SPD-007]].

Decided by Eric on 2026-09-12, on the design in `docs/design/2026-09-12-team-card.md`: the worked-on sentence sits on each member's line in the member tree under the table rather than in a table column, because a paragraph column is cramped in reading view; tokens show as out, in and cached from the member's own transcript rather than one total that is mostly cache reads.

Done when: opening any ticket note in Obsidian shows the team table, the member tree with each member's worked-on sentence, and the embedded view, and each sentence reads as a sentence about the work, not a status line.

## Size, persona and model decision
Two sequential children of Spud, both on opus, the persona tier. No Fable today (Eric's budget, 2026-09-12): any child or headless probe names a non-fable model, haiku for probes.

1. A designer, in the main checkout, because its deliverable is a doc and docs live on `main`: Vitelotte (01) wrote `docs/design/2026-09-12-team-card.md`, committed on `main`. Eric decided its two departures from the brief on 2026-09-12: the worked-on sentence goes on each member's tree line under the stats table, not in a table column, and tokens show as out, in and cached from the member's transcript sum, not one total. Spud accepted the rest: Run ends at the member's return; Team renders from rows alone, with the importer reading tree-line summaries and the new keys back; five member frontmatter keys, each emitted only when known; a one-time summary backfill for five imported members at merge.
2. An engineer, in worktree `spd-010-team-card` (branch `worktree-spd-010-team-card`), implementing sections 1 to 9 of the spec in `bin/spud` and `tests/` with red-first tests.

The worktree is entered when the designer returns rather than at start, since the designer writes no code. Spudagents write nothing under `ledger/`, so section 10 of the spec (the `Fleet.base` Team view, both templates, the CLAUDE.md, spudagent.md and Home.md prose, the summary backfill) is Spud's, on `main` at merge; the card shows once the branch is merged and rendered. Proposal 15 became [[SPD-021]] (P2): until it lands, a foreground member's Tokens cell shows a dash.
